neighbours.label: a quantifier or adjective about to take a generic people/things noun (many things to many people, the right thing, meet new people)
fire: Freedom means many things to many people.
Home means different things to different people.
Try to do the right thing even when it is hard.
At college you will meet new people every week.
She sent a lot of gifts to a lot of people.
Justice can mean many things to many nations.
He always wants to do the right thing for his kids.
The club lets you meet new friends and neighbors.
quiet: Paint the fence many colors with many brushes.
There are many ways to fold a shirt.
Mix the paint in different jars on different shelves.
Try to find the right size even when it is hard.
At college you will buy new books every week.
She spilled a lot of juice on a lot of rugs.
He always takes the right road to the lake.
The club buys new chairs and tables.

notes: Output: the + direction suppresses ' things', ' thing', ' stuff', ' something', the opposite of what the context predicts. Probes separated 'different things to different' from 'different colors in different'.
